supersedes_gap.detail: EXECUTION_MANIFEST_V3 declared real_adapter as a dotted path while IsaacRuntimeAdapter was never instantiated and mode=REAL was passed nowhere. The canonical Arm-A invocation could only refuse, and every readiness level had been measured through the rehearsal adapter

structural.signature: (manifest_path: 'str | pathlib.Path', arm: 'str', repo_root: 'str | pathlib.Path', *, runtime_factory: 'Callable[[], Any] | None' = None) -> 'tuple[Any, Any]'
structural.method: read from the entry point's own signature and body rather than matched against source text, because a dotted path in a docstring would satisfy a regex and satisfied the manifest last time
structural.why_not_sufficient: a default can be correct while nothing ever calls the function. The probe below establishes that the path is actually entered

probe.refusal_reason: manifest unreadable: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 3 (char 2)
probe.filesystem_writes: none -- the lifecycle returns before it creates a root
probe.CLAIM: the authorised entry point constructs the real adapter and enters the real lifecycle
probe.CLAIM_BOUNDARY: this does NOT establish that the PRE capture succeeds, that Isaac launches, that Hospital loads, that the render loop runs or that the collector completes. Those are LEVEL 5 and only a real attempt reaches them

a_correct_probe_is_accepted.detail: the criterion must be able to pass, not merely able to fail

reasons: the lifecycle ran in mode 'REHEARSAL', not REAL
the entry point built the adapter 0 times
the entry point built the adapter 2 times
the entry point did not use the factory it was given
stages were entered before the refusal: ['MANIFEST_VALIDATED']

the_runner_at_the_v6_freeze_has_no_real_.detail: the V6 runner is the tree this gate exists to reject. If it ever passes, the gate stopped measuring anything
reasons: the runner exposes no run_real_arm entry point
run_real_arm does not default to IsaacRuntimeAdapter

real_path_using_the_rehearsal_adapter.detail: the probe reports which adapter was built, so a real path wired to the fake runtime is visible rather than silently green
